overview_description.description: Unlayer offers a 4-in-1 embeddable drag-and-drop content builder designed to help businesses create visually appealing emails, landing pages, documents, and popups without the need for coding. This innovative solution is backed by Y Combinator and has gained the trust of Fortune 500 companies such as Fidelity and Bank of America, as well as leading SaaS platforms like Keap and Hive. Unlayer empowers developers to directly integrate powerful, white-label design tools into their applications, transforming how teams design and collaborate on content.

product.name: Email Builder
product.description: A drag-and-drop email editor that enables creation of responsive, cross-client compatible emails with customizable templates and AI-powered features.

product.name: Page Builder
product.description: A visual, drag-and-drop editor for creating responsive landing pages and web content, fully embeddable and customizable for SaaS platforms.

product.name: Document Builder
product.description: An embeddable drag-and-drop document editor for creating dynamic, customizable PDFs and documents integrated into SaaS platforms.
